courses.name: Hillcrest Drop
courses.blurb: A steep bay city. Bomb the hill through crowded streets, find your own line, and finish with a jump off the pier into the bay.

courses.name: Copperline Mountain
courses.blurb: A huge paved mountain fan. Lines braid, split and rejoin all the way down.

courses.name: Test Slope
courses.blurb: The original movement test hill. Short, simple, good for warming up.
